title: Importer of packaged snacks from China, warehouse in Los Angeles

input.what: Importer of packaged snack food, warehouse

assumptions: The company already exists (Pacific Snack Trading LLC). Hires staff. Moves into a space that needs no construction. No exterior sign.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Employer payroll tax account registration (DE 1)
items.note: Register within 15 days of paying more than $100 in wages in a calendar quarter.

items.name: Business Tax Registration Certificate
items.agency: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance
items.note: "All companies doing business within the City of Los Angeles" need one.
items.match: los angeles business tax|la-btrc|business tax registration

items.name: Food Facility Registration
items.note: Facilities that manufacture, process, pack or hold food register before operations begin; renew Oct-Dec of even years.

items.name: Importer identity (CBP Form 5106)
items.note: Filed with the first formal entry or request for services (19 CFR 24.5).

items.name: Customs bond (CBP Form 301)
items.note: Merchandise isn't released at entry without a single or continuous bond (19 CFR 142.4(a)); the port director may waive it at $2,500 or less.

items.name: Processed Food Registration (general food warehouse)
items.agency: California Department of Public Health, Food and Drug Branch
items.note: "PFR certificates are also required for general food warehouses."
items.agencyMatch: department of public health|food and drug branch

items.name: Prior Notice of imported food (per shipment)
items.condition: Filed for each shipment, not once.

items.name: Seller's permit
items.agency: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration
items.note: "Every location must have this permit to sell taxable goods." Also on the LA restaurant checklist.
items.condition: A wholesaler selling for resale; CDTFA's own rule for wholesalers wasn't read in this pass.

items.name: Workers' compensation insurance
items.agency: California Department of Industrial Relations, Division of Workers' Compensation
items.note: Added in the coverage audit of 2026-10-22: bought from an insurer once there is staff.
items.quote: California employers are required by law to have workers' compensation insurance, even if they have only one employee.

items.name: Foreign supplier verification (FSVP) and the importer's DUNS number at entry
items.note: Added in the coverage audit of 2026-10-22: the US importer of food runs a foreign supplier verification program and gives its DUNS number at entry.
items.quote: the unique facility identifier (UFI) recognized as acceptable by FDA for importer identification is provided electronically when filing entry

mustNotInclude.name: CPSC product certificate
mustNotInclude.why: Food isn't a consumer product under CPSC's certificate rule.

mustNotInclude.name: Retail food health permit
mustNotInclude.why: A warehouse isn't a retail food facility.
mustNotInclude.match: public health permit|food facility plan check
